label: enthukondu: why
note: CLOSED by chapter 73 -- see ML-A1-JOIN-05, which the same chapter closes. The note was right that neither half existed. The question word is entukondu, and it is transparent: entu (what, chapter two) plus kondu (by means of). THREE OF THE FOUR QUESTION WORDS NOW OPEN ON E -- entu, evide and entukondu -- which is the asking letter ML-C41-deixis-system already named when it taught i- for near, a- for far and e- for a question. AARU (who) is the exception and starts on aa; a draft of the lesson claimed all four shared the letter and was corrected.
